sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Someone left a message asking if we could separate out the Cloud Code skills into their own videos. So today we're launching a brand new series, GitHub Trending Skills, episode 1, 35 open source repositories. Let's get started.

sections.title: talk-normal
paragraphs: You ask an AI a simple question and get certainly I'd be happy to explain followed by five paragraphs of robotic fluff. Talknormal is a system prompt that fixes that. Drop it into Claude ChatgPT or your local LLM and it strips away the AI slop. No filler, no restating the question, no robotic transitions, just direct, concise, structurally sound answers.

sections.title: MiniMax Skills
paragraphs: Minia AI skills is an official skills kit that turns clawed code into senior engineers. Strict production grade workflows force the AI through requirements analysis, architecture design, then implementation. Expert skill packs for full stack React, Android, iOS, and even complex GLSL shaders. Ask your agent in the IDE to write and sing a personalized song or convert a photo into an animated Funko Pop sticker using their generation APIs.

sections.title: npxskillui
paragraphs: Ever looked at Stripe or Apple and wished you could steal their entire design system? NPX Skillwe reverse engineers design systems from any URL, GitHub repo, or local project with one command. No AI involved, no API keys required. Pure static analysis. Default mode extracts design tokens, fonts, and hex colors. Ultra mode fires up headless playright to capture scroll journeys, hover interactions, and complex CSS animations.

sections.title: email-campaigns-claude
paragraphs: Email campaigns-claude is an autonomous email agent that connects Claude code directly to the Reesend API. Give it a prompt like draft a three-part welcome sequence for new users. And Claude writes the copy, codes the HTML layouts, optimizes subject lines, and dispatches the bulk emails via Rezend. Your terminal becomes a full-time marketing manager. No SAS menus, no subscription fees.

sections.title: harness
paragraphs: Harness is a meta skill that builds the entire AI team for you. Type build a harness for this project and it analyzes your domain, picks from six architectures like producer, reviewer or hierarchical delegation, then generates all the specialized agent definitions and custom skills needed for them to collaborate. Handles inter agent data passing, error handling, and orchestration automatically.

sections.title: antivibe
paragraphs: Your AI writes the code, you ship the feature, you learn absolutely nothing. Antivibe is a clawed code skill that fixes that. After every coding session, automatic hooks trigger a specialized sub aent that generates a deep dive markdown file explaining why the AI wrote the code that way. What CS patterns are in play and curated resources to learn more. Runs in the background with zero friction. Works with any language.

sections.title: autoskills
paragraphs: Autoskills is a CLI that installs your entire AI skill stack with one command. Run npx autosklls in your project root and it scans your package JSON and config files to detect your exact text stack. Next.js, Tailwind, Spring Boot, whatever you're using. Automatically pulls the best community curated markdown skills from the skills.sh registry straight into your project.

sections.title: logo-generator-skill
paragraphs: AI image generators give you messy bit maps with weird text. You wanted a logo, you got a mess. Logo generator skill uses clawed code to write the raw SVG code for your logo. Tell it your project name and industry. Get six geometric vector-based design variations. Pure SVG means infinitely scalable, fully responsive, and you can drag it straight into Figma to tweak radiants and layout.

sections.title: material-3-skill
paragraphs: Claude code generates UIs that look sort of like material design, but ignore the actual strict guidelines. Material 3 skill turns your AI into a certified Google Material Design 3 expert. 30 plus components, the full dynamic tonal color system, and responsive layout breakpoints. Feed it one seed color and get a perfectly balanced light and dark mode theme.

sections.title: lich-skills
paragraphs: Lich Skills injects a strict specdriven development workflow into your agent, forcing it to plan and design architecture before writing a single line of code. Beyond that, it equips your AI with live web search via the Tavali API to look up latest documentation and hooks into Nano Banana for instant image generation right from your terminal.

sections.title: 3gpp-skill
paragraphs: 3GP skill turns Claude into a senior telecom consultant grounded in actual engineering standards from 2G through 6G and release 21. Ask complex questions like how 5G protects against IMSI catchers or how to migrate from LTE to 5G core and it maps the entire protocol flow across the PI, MAC, and RC layers. Every single answer backed by exact technical specification references. No hallucinations.

sections.title: inside-lago-voice-skill
paragraphs: AI writing sounds like AI writing inside Lagovoice skill fixes that the founder of Lago had multiple viral hacker news hits and just open sourced the exact claw skill she used to write them. A framework for teaching an AI to write like you not a corporate version of you. Seven structured sections including voice core rules and an anti-filler checklist. You feed it your personal anti-patterns the exact manual edits you always make to fix AI drafts.

sections.title: marp-slides
paragraphs: Marp slides is a Claude code skill that turns your agent into a master presentation designer. It uses 22 curated reference decks to teach Claude how to compose beautiful MARP decks using pure markdown and raw HTML. Prompt it with create a dark mode presentation reviewing my Q1 sales data and it autonomously builds the entire deck with SVG bar charts, metric cards, and polished layouts.

sections.title: SkillClaw
paragraphs: Managing a swarm of AI agents means when one tool breaks, every agent on your team fails the same way until you manually rewrite the code. Skillclaw fixes that with collective skill evolution. A local proxy silently monitors your agents. When one discovers a new workflow or hits an error, an autonomous agentic evolver analyzes the session, dynamically rewrites the tools logic, and syncs the upgrade to a shared cloud repository.

sections.title: svg-hand-drawn-skill
paragraphs: SVG handdrawn skill plugs into clawed code or cursor. Feed it a rigid corporate SVG chart, logo or icon, and it converts it into a beautiful rough hand-drawn style graphic. It doesn't output a static image. It generates a complete HTML preview with a player script that animates the SVG, making it look like the graphic is being physically sketched onto the screen in real time.

sections.title: buffett-skills
paragraphs: Buffett skills distills Warren Buffett's entire value investing brain into an autonomous agent skill. Drop the skill.mmd into claude code or openclaw and it transforms your agent into a ruthless fundamental value investor. Give it an annual report or ticker. It runs structured analysis on economic moat management integrity intrinsic value and long-term capital allocation.

sections.title: PaperOrchestra
paragraphs: Paper Orchestra transforms your single AI assistant into a full academic ensemble. Outline agent, plotting agent, literature review agent, and content refiner. Feed it your messy prewriting notes, and the swarm synthesizes a deep literature review, generates conceptual diagrams, iteratively refineses clarity through simulated peer review, and outputs a perfectly formatted latex file.

sections.title: how
paragraphs: Staring at a massive undocumented legacy codebase is one of the worst feelings in software. How is a cursor plugin that adds a slow command to your workspace. Ask how does the message virtualization work and instead of a raw code snippet, you get a structured architectural explanation like a senior staff engineer onboarding you to the team. Running a Shopify store means clicking through

sections.title: shopify-admin-skills
paragraphs: hundreds of admin pages or paying for expensive third party apps. Shopify admin-skills is a collection of 63 AI agent skills built specifically for operating Shopify stores. Install it with npx skills ad authenticate with the Shopify CLI and your local AI agent becomes an e-commerce manager.

sections.title: ai-life-skills
paragraphs: AI life skills is a collection of markdown skill files that transform clawed code into a proactive life coach. Analyzes your daily journal entries to detect burnout. reviews your calendar to aggressively schedule deep work blocks, automates daily reflection logs, catch yourself infinite scrolling on Twitter during a focus block, and it literally shuts down the browser tab via OS command and forces you to type a reflection on why you broke focus.

sections.title: paper-finder
paragraphs: Paperfinder is a clawed code skill explicitly tuned for deep ML literature research. Drop it in your workspace and your AI agent acts like a senior PhD adviser instead of a dumb search bar. The creator tested it on bleeding edge topics like mixed resolution diffusion and efficient video tokenization. It consistently unears hidden gem papers that traditional search engines completely miss.

sections.title: engineering-figure-banana
paragraphs: Engineering figure banana is a clawed code skill with a dual mode architecture that separates conceptual diagrams from quantitative plots. System architecture or algorithm workflow goes through an image model benchmark chart or scatter plot where the numbers actually matter forces plot mode and writes exact code to render the geometry locally.

sections.title: awesome-cursor-skills
paragraphs: Cursor just introduced agent skills, but figuring out how to write good ones takes trial and error. Awesome. Cursor skills is a curated collection of readytouse skills you paste directly into your cursor/skills/directory suggesting cursor rules watches your corrections and if you keep fixing the same styling mistake autonomously proposes a permanent rule.

sections.title: skill-based-architecture
paragraphs: Skill-based architecture is a meta skill designed to organize your other skills. feed it your long single file prompts or scattered project rules and it autonomously refactors them into a structured skills directory tree. Monolithic instructions get broken into modular purpose-built files. Your agent only reads the exact content it needs exactly when it needs it.

sections.title: seedance-skill
paragraphs: Making an Apple Keynote style promo video usually takes days in After Effects and 3D software. Seance skill automates it entirely. This clawed code skill integrates Bite Dance's Cance 2.0 motion graphics model straight into your terminal via the FAL AI API. Point your agent at an app store link or a folder of screenshots. It uses specialized liquid glass prompting to autonomously generate a glossy cinematic promo clip.

sections.title: friday-showcase
paragraphs: Friday is a fully autonomous 247 AI assistant built using nothing but clawed code CLI and a single markdown file. The entire brain lives in that file, backed by a tiny flask server for persistent rag memory. It sends morning weather and crypto briefings via Telegram, monitors hugging face for new models, pushes git commits, transcribes YouTube videos, and creates self-healing cron jobs. Agentic SEO from Adi Osmani is Google Lighthouse, but specifically for AI

sections.title: agentic-seo
paragraphs: agent readiness. Run it against your site or docs, and it scans for machine readable signals like lms.exty texty files, clean markdown, and strict token limits. Make sure your API references don't blow out an agents context window. Checks whether you have skill.md or agents.md files exposed so bots know how to navigate your codebase.

sections.title: html-ppt-skill
paragraphs: PowerPoint and Google Slides are tedious. HTML PPT skill automates presentations entirely. An installable claude code skill that turns your agent into a professional presentation designer. Feed it a rough outline or markdown. It outputs a single self-contained HTML slide deck. 24 themes, 31 layouts, 20 plus built-in animations. Everything bundled with inline CSS and JavaScript runs perfectly in any browser.

sections.title: caveman-claude-skill
paragraphs: AI agents burn tokens writing polite essays just to give you one line of code. Caveman Claude's skill is an ultra compressed communication mode that forces your AI to talk like a literal caveman. Drops articles, filler, and hedging while preserving 100% of the technical accuracy and code blocks. Cuts output token usage by up to 75%. Adjustable intensity levels, including a classical Chinese mode for extreme character compression.

sections.title: manual-SDD
paragraphs: Keeping system prompts, and project rules in sync across clawed code, cursor, and codecs is painful. Manual SDDD is a skills first starter kit you drop into your repo that introduces specd-driven development for the AI era. Instead of configuring each tool separately, you maintain a single canonical AI specs folder. Clever sim links make your cursor.claude andcodex directories all read from the exact same centralized playbook.

sections.title: hue
paragraphs: Hugh is an installable clawed code skill that learns any brand from a URL, company name, or screenshot and instantly reverse engineers it into a complete reusable design system. Color tokens, typography scales, plus strict recipes for light and dark modes. Run the install command and drop it into yourcloud/skills folder. Every interface your AI builds from that moment is strictly bound to that custom design language.

sections.title: compose_skill
paragraphs: Jetack Compose audit skill is like having a senior Android architect review your codebase. It doesn't just use generic LLM prompts. It runs a built-in gradal script to generate and parse your raw compose compiler metrics. Combines that hard deterministic compiler data with AI reasoning to give your project a brutal quantified audit score out of 100.

sections.title: my-ai-workflow
paragraphs: My AI workflow is Mateo Barbaro's battle tested methodology, open-sourced. Instead of diving straight into prompts, a custom skill forces the AI to interview you first. Explore the codebase, ask hard architectural questions, walk every branch of the design tree, resolve dependencies, all before a single line of code gets written. The output is a structured PRD that becomes the source of truth for your agents going forward.

sections.title: spider-king-skill
paragraphs: Scraping a modern web page with AI usually ends in disaster, blocked by Cloudflare or drowning your context window in thousands of lines of useless HTML. Spider King skill is the drop-in webcwler skill for AI assistance. handles headless browser rendering, navigates antibbot protections, and strips away DOM noise automatically, feeds clean, structured markdown or JSON directly into your LLM's memory.

sections.title: android-skills-mcp
paragraphs: Google's official Android team dropped a massive repository of AI skills, covering canonical best practices for XML to Jetack compose migrations, but manually reformatting raw markdown for every AI tool is a nightmare. Android Skills MCP is an MCP server and CLI packager from SkyOVE that bridges all of it. One npx command translates Google's raw skills into native rule formats for seven different AI agents. [music]
